# server.external

> Enriches citations from Semantic Scholar, singly or as an ingest-time batch.

<!-- Generated by scripts/modules/generate-agents.mjs from module.manifest.json
     and module.narrative.md. Edit those, not this file. -->

The per-lookup cache and the DOI/arXiv/title lookup ladder are internal —
callers get one `enrichCitation()` and should not care which of the three resolved it.

Enrichment is best-effort: a failed lookup must degrade the citation, never fail the answer
that carries it.

## Interface

Entrypoint: `index.ts`

Anything not listed here is internal to this module:

- `enrichCitation`
- `enrichCitationsBatch`
- `CitationEnrichmentInput`
- `SemanticScholarPaper`

## Uses

Read only the *interface* of these — never their internals.

- **server.config** via `getTimeout / getUrl`

## Constraints

Work outside these has left this module. Stop and ask rather than widening the boundary.

- outbound lookups
- response caching
- rate-limit backoff
- single-flight

## Checks

Green here means the bounded work is done — no need to run the whole repo.

```bash
pnpm vitest run src/server/external
```
